01.name: Stone and Beam Westview
01.shortDesc: A sturdy hardwood-frame sofa featuring plush cushions for ultimate family comfort.
01.description: The Stone and Beam Westview sofa combines classic craftsmanship with everyday durability. Designed with high-resiliency foam cushions and a solid hardwood frame, it offers long-lasting support and timeless elegance for your living room.

02.name: Rivet Bigelow Modern
02.shortDesc: Sleek mid-century design with tapered legs and luxurious upholstery.
02.description: Bring a touch of vintage flair to your home with the Rivet Bigelow Modern sofa. Featuring clean lines, soft yet supportive cushioning, and durable wooden legs, it is an ideal centerpiece for contemporary living spaces.

03.name: Amazon Brand Modern Sofa
03.shortDesc: Minimalist and compact design tailored for apartments and urban spaces.
03.description: This modern sofa offers smart space-saving proportions without sacrificing comfort. Wrapped in breathable, high-grade fabric with an engineered wood frame, it provides reliable daily seating with effortless style.

26.name: Rivet Bigelow Modern
26.shortDesc: Sleek mid-century design with tapered legs and luxurious upholstery.
26.description: Bring a touch of vintage flair to your home with the Rivet Bigelow Modern sofa. Featuring clean lines, soft yet supportive cushioning, and durable wooden legs, it is an ideal centerpiece for contemporary living spaces.

04.name: Fluffy Sheep Sofa
04.shortDesc: Ultra-soft textured fabric finish designed for maximum relaxation.
04.description: Indulge in cozy comfort with the Fluffy Sheep Sofa. Its plush, textured upholstery feels exceptionally soft against the skin, making it the ultimate lounging spot for reading or unwinding after a long day.

05.name: Faux Velvet Sofa
05.shortDesc: Rich velvet texture offering a luxurious look and plush seating experience.
05.description: Elevate your interior decor with the elegant sheen of our Faux Velvet Sofa. Crafted with dense padding and premium velvet fabric, it adds a sophisticated and chic accent to modern and eclectic rooms.

06.name: Fluffy Sheep Sofa
06.shortDesc: Ultra-soft textured fabric finish designed for maximum relaxation.
06.description: Indulge in cozy comfort with the Fluffy Sheep Sofa. Its plush, textured upholstery feels exceptionally soft against the skin, making it the ultimate lounging spot for reading or unwinding after a long day.

07.name: Sakarias Armchair
07.shortDesc: Ergonomic armchair designed to provide exceptional back support and style.
07.description: The Sakarias Armchair blends ergonomic contouring with elegant aesthetics. Whether placed in a reading nook or as an accent piece in your living room, it delivers reliable comfort and graceful style.

27.name: Modern Arm Sofa
27.shortDesc: Compact single-arm sofa built for modern lounge areas.
27.description: A sleek and versatile seating solution, the Modern Arm Sofa features a streamlined profile and supportive cushions. Perfect for compact spaces looking for a clean, contemporary aesthetic.

08.name: Baltsar Chair
08.shortDesc: Lightweight, contemporary accent chair with sturdy wooden legs.
08.description: The Baltsar Chair offers clean Scandinavian design lines and reliable durability. Its lightweight structure makes it easy to reposition around your home while maintaining a chic decorative appeal.

09.name: Helmar Chair
09.shortDesc: Padded accent chair featuring deep cushioning and durable upholstery.
09.description: Designed for prolonged seating comfort, the Helmar Chair features generous padding and robust construction. It serves as a stylish and comfortable addition to dining areas or study rooms.

10.name: Apple iPhone 12 Pro
10.shortDesc: Advanced dual-camera system, A14 Bionic chip, and brilliant Super Retina XDR display.
10.description: The Apple iPhone 12 Pro delivers lightning-fast performance and pro-grade photography capabilities. Equipped with Night mode, Ceramic Shield front cover, and immersive display technology, it is built to perform brilliantly.

25.name: Sakarias Armchair
25.shortDesc: Ergonomic armchair designed to provide exceptional back support and style.
25.description: The Sakarias Armchair blends ergonomic contouring with elegant aesthetics. Whether placed in a reading nook or as an accent piece in your living room, it delivers reliable comfort and graceful style.

11.name: Apple iPhone 12 Max
11.shortDesc: Large-screen flagship smartphone with exceptional battery life and fluid performance.
11.description: Experience expansive visuals and powerful processing with the iPhone 12 Max. Featuring a stunning large OLED display, advanced camera optics, and long-lasting battery capacity for all-day productivity.

12.name: Realme 8
12.shortDesc: Vibrant Super AMOLED display and fast-charging capabilities in a slim profile.
12.description: The Realme 8 is engineered for speed and clarity, featuring a vivid display, capable multi-lens camera setup, and rapid battery charging support to keep up with your active lifestyle.

13.name: One Plus Nord
13.shortDesc: Smooth 90Hz fluid AMOLED display and robust Snapdragon performance.
13.description: OnePlus Nord delivers flagship-level smoothness and premium photography features at an accessible price. Enjoy a seamless user experience, fast multitasking, and clean software.

14.name: Apple iPhone 13 Pro
14.shortDesc: Pro camera system with macro photography, Cinematic mode, and ProMotion display.
14.description: The iPhone 13 Pro pushes the boundaries of smartphone capability with its breakthrough ProMotion display, lightning-fast A15 Bionic chip, and professional-grade video recording features.

15.name: Samsung Galaxy S22
15.shortDesc: Dynamic AMOLED 2X display, nightography camera, and sleek armor aluminum frame.
15.description: The Samsung Galaxy S22 combines cutting-edge mobile innovation with a refined design. Capture stunning low-light photos and enjoy ultra-smooth scrolling on a brilliant, vibrant display.

16.name: Rolex Watch
16.shortDesc: Timeless luxury timepiece crafted with precision automatic movement.
16.description: An iconic symbol of status and precision engineering, this luxury timepiece features robust stainless steel construction, a sophisticated dial, and dependable Swiss automatic movement.

17.name: Timex Easy Reader Watch
17.shortDesc: Classic casual watch featuring clear Arabic numerals and INDIGLO backlight.
17.description: The Timex Easy Reader offers effortless readability and classic everyday style. Equipped with a genuine leather strap and reliable quartz movement, it is a dependable companion for any occasion.

18.name: Rolex Watch
18.shortDesc: Exquisite luxury wrist watch with sophisticated dial detailing.
18.description: Blending elegance with enduring performance, this luxury watch makes a bold statement on the wrist. Built with scratch-resistant crystal and high-grade materials for lasting durability.

19.name: Apple Watch
19.shortDesc: Advanced fitness tracking, ECG monitoring, and seamless notifications on your wrist.
19.description: Stay connected, active, and healthy with the Apple Watch. Featuring comprehensive workout metrics, blood oxygen sensing, and a brilliant always-on retina display.

20.name: Beat Studio Wireless
20.shortDesc: Active Noise Cancelling (ANC) headphones with premium acoustics and deep bass.
20.description: Immerse yourself in pure sound with Beat Studio Wireless headphones. Featuring real-time audio calibration, long battery life, and plush over-ear cushions for all-day listening comfort.

22.name: Beat EP Headphones
22.shortDesc: Battery-free sleek on-ear headphones delivering masterfully tuned sound.
22.description: The Beat EP headphones offer battery-free lightweight listening with robust durability. Engineered with stainless steel reinforcement and crisp acoustic performance for music lovers.

privacy.label: YOUR PRIVACY MATTERS
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Your trust matters to us. Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.
privacy.introDescription: This policy explains how we handle your personal information when you visit or shop through our website.
privacy.contactDescription: Our team is here to help with any privacy-related questions.

information.title: 1. Information We Collect
information.content: When you use our website, we may collect personal information such as your name, email address, phone number, shipping address, and account details. We also collect information about your orders and shopping activity.

usage.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
usage.content: We use your information to process orders, manage your account, provide customer support, improve our website, communicate important updates, and maintain the security of our services.

sharing.title: 3. Information Sharing
sharing.content: We do not sell your personal information. We may share necessary information with service providers who help us operate our store, process orders, manage payments, and deliver products.

security.title: 4. Data Security
security.content: We take reasonable measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of internet transmission or electronic storage is completely secure.

cookies.title: 5. Cookies and Website Technologies
cookies.content: Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience, remember preferences, and understand how visitors interact with our website.

thirdParty.title: 6. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: Our store uses third-party services, including Firebase for authentication and database services and Cloudinary for image hosting. These providers may process information according to their own privacy policies.

rights.title: 7. Your Privacy Rights
rights.content: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, subject to applicable legal requirements. You can also contact us with questions about how your information is handled.

children.title: 8. Children's Privacy
children.content: Our website is not intended for children under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

changes.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be published on this page along with an updated revision date.

contact.title: 10. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or the way we handle your personal information, please contact our support team.
